rationale: The Chief Justice is best positioned to hold the 7-Justice coalition together with a functional Edmond/Arthrex supervision analysis and a narrow Free Enterprise Fund-style remedial disposition reversing the Fifth Circuit’s broad set-aside. Thomas is likely to write a principal dissent focused on the self-executing legal effect and lack of principal-officer review, with a meaningful chance of an Alito separate dissent or partial join given his distinct textualist/remedy emphasis.
